chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Whoever swears privately, let him make the exception privately; and whoever swears publicly, let him make the exception publicly.

key_terms.فَلْيَسْتَثْنِ: let him make an exception to his oath

ai.seo_question: If someone makes an oath publicly or privately, how should the exception to it be made?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the manner of making an exception to an oath should correspond to the manner in which the oath was made. If the oath was private, the exception should be private; and if it was public, the exception should be public.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4301 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever takes an oath in private should make an exception in private, and whoever takes an oath publicly should make an exception publicly."
